_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwema {player_id}, mi ɖo {num_rounds} ɖo Iterated Ultimatum Game.
A nyi ${pool} mi ɖo le ɖo ɖo si mi kpo to azɔnwema {other_id}.

Azɔnwema ɖo:
  - Ɖo asɛ: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Nɛ gbɛ wɛ azɔ, A nyi na $(pool - X), azɔnwema kpo na $X
  - Nɛ gbɛ ma wɛ azɔ, A nyi ɖo kpo na $0
  - Apɛsɛ: [Offer: $3]  alo  'Mɛ sɛ ɖo ɖo ɖo. [Offer: $5]'

Azɔnwema kpo:
  - Ɖo asɛ ɖo na [Accept] alo [Reject]
  - Apɛsɛ: 'Ɛ jɛ ɖo ɖo. [Accept]'
            'Ɛ ma ɖo ɖo. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Ɖo {round_number} bɛɖɛ! ---
Azɔnwema {proposer_id} ɖo azɔnwema ɖo, Azɔnwema {responder_id} ɖo azɔnwema kpo.
round.offer: Alọgọ ṣin ṣọṣi {round_number}: Agba ṣinatọ̀n {proposer_id} dọ̀n alọgọ ${offer} hẹ Agba ṣinatọ̀n {responder_id} (nado mọ ${keep}).
round.accepted: Agba ṣinatọ̀n {responder_id} jlo alọgọ! Alọgọ ṣin ṣọṣi {round_number}: Agba ṣinatọ̀n {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Agba ṣinatọ̀n {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Pọsunu titengbe: Agba ṣinatọ̀n 0: ${total_0}, Agba ṣinatọ̀n 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Agba ṣinatọ̀n {responder_id} ma jlo alọgọ! Alọgọ ṣin ṣọṣi {round_number}: Mọyi na mọ $0. Pọsunu lẹ zẹemẹdo: Agba ṣinatọ̀n 0: ${total_0}, Agba ṣinatọ̀n 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Mɛ e na w'azɔ̌ ɔ ná é ɖó na zán nùjlɛ́n [Offer: $X] tɔn dó bló tuto.
invalid_move.bad_integer: akwɛ e è na sɔ́ dó xɔ ɔ ná é ɖó na nyí nùjlɛ̌n ɖagbe ɖé.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Akwɛ ɔ ɖo na nɔ tɛntin $0 kpo ${pool} kpo.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Gbɛ̀ azɔ gbɛ̀ ɖi kɛ wɛ̀.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Respondè do àlọ tọn dehe na tindo avase yi [Accept] kavi [Reject] dọ ema.

outcome.win: Agba ṣinatọ̀n he ye ji {winner} gba na gbẹ̀, pọsunu ${winner_total} wutu, bo ṣẹṣẹ sọn Agba ṣinatọ̀n he ye ji {loser} he mọ pọsunu ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Gbɛ̀ gbɛ̀! Player kpɛkpɛ wèzɔ ${total} gbɛ̀ gbɛ̀.
